children: Impinj agreed to exchange $56.3 million principal of its 1.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027 for approximately $56.5 million in cash and ~188,451 shares of common stock.
Privately negotiated exchange covers $56.3M aggregate principal of 2027 Notes for ~ $56.5M cash and ~188,451 shares (estimates).
Cash and share amounts subject to adjustment during a 2‑day measurement period ending Sept 14, 2026; closings ~Sept 16, 2026.
Impinj will fund the exchange with cash on hand; about $1.0M principal of the 2027 Notes will remain outstanding.
Shares issued in the exchange will be offered in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A.
